source: AFL Tables game pages (https://afltables.com/afl/stats/games/<year>/<id>.html), the official per-player match statistics, every 2023-2025 match including finals (216 a season, 648 matches, 1296 team-matches). ruck1 = the side's player with the most hit-outs in that match (the sim harness's definition), ruck2 = the next most, rest = team total minus ruck1. Each team total is checked against the page's Totals row. Percentiles are over team-matches; margins and gaps over matches. Built by build_ruck_splits.py from a cache of the pages.

keys.ruck1_hitouts: top ruck's hit-outs (most on his side that match)
keys.rest_hitouts: team hit-outs not by the top ruck
keys.ruck1_share_pct: top ruck's share of his side's hit-outs, %
keys.ruck2_share_pct: second ruck's share of his side's hit-outs, %
keys.ruck1_share_at_least_pct: % of team-matches where the top ruck took at least this share
keys.rest_at_most_pct: % of team-matches where the rest of the side took at most N hit-outs
keys.ruck1_at_least_pct: % of team-matches where the top ruck had at least N hit-outs
keys.ruck2_at_most_pct: % of team-matches where the second ruck had at most N hit-outs
keys.ruck2_at_least_pct: % of team-matches where the second ruck had at least N hit-outs
keys.match_hitout_margin: hit-out margin between the two sides (per match)
keys.match_hitout_margin_at_least_pct: % of matches with a hit-out margin of at least N
keys.match_one_side_share_at_least_pct: % of matches where one side took at least this share of all hit-outs
keys.ruck1_head_to_head_gap: gap between the two top rucks' hit-outs (per match)
keys.ruck1_head_to_head_gap_at_least_pct: % of matches where the two top rucks were at least N apart
